description: Defines the LatencyTracker class for tracking input event latency in Android's input dispatcher, including methods for tracking events, finishing events, and reporting latency data.

classes.name: LatencyTracker
classes.description: Class responsible for tracking input event latency, managing timelines, and reporting mature event data.

methods.name: LatencyTracker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the LatencyTracker with a processor.

methods.name: trackListener
methods.description: Starts tracking an input event identified by inputEventId.

methods.name: trackFinishedEvent
methods.description: Marks an input event as finished with associated timing and connection info.

methods.name: trackGraphicsLatency
methods.description: Records graphics latency timeline for an input event.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current state for debugging.
